title: Personal Checking: deciding the bank-error refund of an overdraft transfer fee
content:
## Scope

This rule combines the grounds on which the most recently posted overdraft protection transfer fee on a Personal Checking account is a bank error, and fixes the refund that follows.

## Formal clauses

1. **Either ground suffices.** The fee is a bank error when either of two conditions holds: the source savings tier of the transfer is not eligible to serve as an overdraft protection source, or the fee was charged at an amount other than the checking tier's overdraft transfer fee.
2. **Never twice.** A fee that already has a refund entry is never refunded again.
3. **Refund owed.** When the fee is a bank error and has no refund yet, it is refunded in full, never in part, at that fee's own amount, as a bank-error refund.
4. **Otherwise nothing.** In every other case this review refunds nothing, and any goodwill request is decided under the courtesy gates of the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
5. **No rounding.** Fee amounts carry 2 decimal places, so the refund needs no rounding.

## Truth table

| Source savings tier ineligible | Fee at an amount other than the tier's figure | Fee already has a refund entry | Refund under this review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | The fee's own amount, in full |
| No | Yes | No | The fee's own amount, in full |
| Yes | Yes | No | The fee's own amount, in full (one refund, not two) |
| No | No | No | Nothing |
| Yes or No | Yes or No | Yes | Nothing |

## Refund amount: the witness case (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical checking tier's overdraft transfer fee is 8.00 USD, and the fee posted at 12.00 USD with no refund yet. Three readings are conceivable:

| Candidate reading | Refund |
|---|---|
| Refund only the overcharge, 12.00 less 8.00 | 4.00 USD |
| Refund the tier's figure | 8.00 USD |
| Refund the fee in full at its own amount | **12.00 USD** |

Only the third agrees with clause 3: the refund is the fee's own amount, in full, never in part.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a fee that is not a bank error is refused outright". **Correct basis:** this review refunds nothing, and a goodwill request is then decided under the courtesy gates of the general fee refund rules.
- **Wrong reading:** "both grounds holding doubles the refund". **Correct basis:** the fee is refunded once, in full, at its own amount.
